items.exampleEn: Our team won the award for three successive years.
items.exampleZh: 我們團隊連續三年得獎。

items.exampleEn: The advent of the internet changed the way we work.
items.exampleZh: 網路的出現改變了我們的工作方式。

items.exampleEn: The power went off momentarily during the storm.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨期間停電了一下子。

items.exampleEn: The phone can run several simultaneous tasks without slowing down.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機能同時執行好幾個任務，也不會變慢。

items.exampleEn: Her simple black dress has a timeless style.
items.exampleZh: 她那件簡單的黑洋裝有種不退流行的風格。
items.glossZh: 永恆的；不受時間影響的

items.exampleEn: Their success was transient; the shop closed a year later.
items.exampleZh: 他們的成功很短暫，那家店一年後就關了。

items.exampleEn: Some of the words in this old dictionary are rather dated.
items.exampleZh: 這本舊字典裡有些字詞相當過時了。

items.exampleEn: There was a momentary silence after the announcement.
items.exampleZh: 宣佈之後，現場安靜了片刻。

items.sentenceEn: The two meetings are simultaneous, so I can only attend one.
items.sentenceZh: 兩場會議同時舉行，所以我只能參加一場。

items.audioEn: The website was momentarily down this morning, but it is working again now.
items.audioZh: 網站今天早上短暫當機了一下，但現在又恢復正常了。

items.sentenceEn: It rained for five successive days during our trip.
items.sentenceZh: 我們旅行期間連續下了五天雨。

items.sentenceEn: Good music is timeless; people still love these old songs.
items.sentenceZh: 好音樂是永恆的；大家依然喜愛這些老歌。

items.stemEn: There was a ____ pause before everyone started clapping.
items.stemZh: 大家開始鼓掌之前，有片刻的停頓。

items.stemEn: This phone looks ____ now; nobody uses that design anymore.
items.stemZh: 這支手機現在看起來很過時；已經沒有人用那種設計了。

items.passageEn: For decades, the clothing company Hana was famous for its timeless designs. However, the advent of online shopping brought fast changes, and many customers began to think Hana's styles looked dated. Sales fell for three successive years. At first, the managers thought the problem was transient and would soon pass. They were utterly wrong. In the end, they hired a young designer and launched two simultaneous projects: a new online shop and a cheaper line of clothes for students. Sales went up quickly. They dropped momentarily when prices rose last year, but overall, the company is doing well again.
items.passageZh: 幾十年來，服飾公司 Hana 以永不過時的設計聞名。然而，網路購物的出現帶來快速的變化，許多顧客開始覺得 Hana 的款式過時了。銷售連續三年下滑。起初，經理們以為這個問題很短暫，很快就會過去。他們完全錯了。最後，他們聘請了一位年輕設計師，同時推出兩項計畫：一個新的網路商店，以及一個給學生的平價服飾系列。銷售很快就回升了。去年漲價時銷售曾短暫下跌，但整體來說，公司又恢復了好成績。

questions.questionZh: Hana 的銷售為什麼下滑？
options: 原本的資深設計師離職了
顧客覺得它的款式過時

questions.questionZh: 公司後來同時推出了哪兩項計畫？
options: 週年打折活動和新的會員卡
網路商店和學生平價系列
海外分店和全新的電視廣告

items.promptZh: 這股流行只是短暫的，明年大家就會忘了。
referenceEn: This trend is only transient; next year, everyone will forget it.
The trend is transient, and people will forget about it next year.
rubricZh: transient 當形容詞，表示短暫、很快就會過去（例如 is only transient）
「明年大家就會忘了」用表示未來的寫法（例如 will forget）；兩句可用分號、and、so 等連接

items.promptZh: 她連續第三個晚上留在辦公室加班。
referenceEn: She worked late at the office for the third successive night.
For the third successive night, she stayed late at the office to work.
rubricZh: successive 放在名詞前（例如 the third successive night 等）
「加班」可寫，例如 worked late、stayed late to work、worked overtime 等
時態可用過去式或現在進行式（例如 worked、is working 等）
